reviews.author: Scott Servante
reviews.text:
This film lab is truly the best. I was a little hesitant about having film developed or scanned while traveling, but I decided to give it a try. I discovered this place after reading a Reddit post telling people where to buy a film camera and develop film in Seoul. Although it is small, it never disappoints. Not only do they sell a variety of films, but they also have a surprisingly large selection of Lomography cameras. They had all the latest film related products. The staff were really friendly and spoke English well, which was nice. In particular, I talked quite a bit with one person who worked on the phenomenon.

One of the special things about this lab (as well as other places) is that you can scan and edit developed film directly. If you leave the film and wait for about 20 minutes (there is a separate space where you can sit and wait), you can scan it with the scanner. Developing film was a really cool experience for someone who did it for the first time. Another thing to note is that the development cost is really cheap. I got high resolution scans for £3 a roll, but in London you'll have to pay £10 for them. I was really surprised. There is also a service that scans the film and sends it to you by email, so you don't have to scan the film yourself.

Summary: If you take film photos in Seoul, I 100% recommend getting them developed here. You will never regret it.

PS: It's a bit strange that there are only 5 reviews, but since it's a Korean film lab, most of the reviews are probably on Naver.

reviews.author: Travelwithyala
reviews.text: It was a really cool first experience developing film myself. It even develops film and allows you to scan it yourself. The development process took less than 5 minutes, which was really impressive. It was really cool to edit the photos myself!😎

reviews.author: Vanessa Neo
reviews.text: I visited on my last day in Seoul, and luckily I was able to complete film development, scanning, and editing within an hour! The photos turned out really well, and the total cost was less than 6 Singapore dollars. It was really cheap! The staff were friendly and although they didn't speak English very well, they were very helpful. If I go to Seoul, I definitely want to visit again, and I highly recommend it to anyone interested in film photography! We also sell cameras, film rolls, and key chains/stickers.

reviews.author: Ga young Bae
reviews.text: A bar in Itaewon that I've been frequenting for two years. There are usually a lot of tasteless and expensive bars in Itaewon, but I often go here because the food is delicious and the prices are reasonable. Originally, it was a chain restaurant specializing in Jjolmyeon called Jaseongdang, but this is Jaseongdang Pub, and it has quite a menu with various types of Jjolmyeon and alcoholic beverages. I tried marbled bibim jjolmyeon with marbled meat, beef hotpot, abalone sundae, and Jaseongdang jjolbokki, and they were all delicious. In particular, Jaseongdang Jjolbokki contains fried rice cakes, sausages, and fish cakes, and the sauce is delicious, so I ordered it often. Marbled bibim jjolmyeon is the main menu at this restaurant, and of course, marbled beef and jjolmyeon go very well together. Beef hotpot is a Japanese dish made with beaten egg yolk and dipped in brisket. The broth is also delicious. The abalone sundae I recently had is a sundae with abalone in it. Half of it is fried and half is boiled. The flavor of the abalone is very good when dipped in the sauce. The owner here has a sense of challenge(?), so there are always various menus available every time I go. Anyway, this is a soju restaurant that’s great for filling up your stomach for a first stop in Itaewon. The owner looks scary, but he is very kind.

It's a gamjatang restaurant, but the bone stew is a real soup that only those in the know know about.
I eat it once a week. If I don't eat it, I'll think about it.
Really delicious

reviews.author: min soo kim
reviews.text: This is a great place when you want warm soup.

reviews.author: cj chung
reviews.text: Bone haejangguk 7,000 won. More than basic

reviews.author: Min
reviews.text:
STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE I'M TELLING YA.
Look at this nasty gray residue that takes only two seconds to remove before serving. The meat was chewy, and the soup was terribly sweet. My partner ordered galbitang, and it only had a small amount of fatty meat left on the bone.
People say the servers are unkind to foreign visitors. Turns out they treat everyone very regardless of nationality (yes, I’m Korean). There are plenty of good restaurants around this area guys.
If you’re reading this comment and wondering whether you should still try this place, abort the mission and thank me later. I took one for you.

Really sweet and chewy bulgogi.... The gray blood residue floating on top was removed with a ladle in 2 seconds before serving to the guests, but instead of doing that, it was served as in the photo. The galbitang was the worst of my life, not even worth taking a picture of. The only thing attached to the meat is fat, and even the odor is gone. I read in the reviews that they even target foreigners. Shouldn't this kind of restaurant be audited by the district office? Wow, I really don't write reviews like this, but this place is the worst.

reviews.author: Ga young Bae
reviews.text:
It's open until the wee hours of the morning, so it's a place I often eat for hangovers before heading home. When Itaewon was crowded, there were so many customers around 5 a.m. that there was a wait, but it was quiet around midnight. This is a place where you can get everything from meat to single meals.
I ordered pork belly, but it came as frozen pork belly. It's all cut thinly, so you can grill it quickly, and it's provided with pepper, so you can sprinkle it liberally and grill it. The side dishes are just as good as at a regular meat restaurant. For a place that was open until dawn, the meat didn't smell bad and it was great to have a drink with.
I also ordered vegetable bibimbap, and it was simple, clean, and delicious.
I don't really remember the taste of galbitang since I always drink a lot, but it's pretty good.
When I came when there were a lot of people, I thought it was a little unfriendly, but it was average. There was only one bathroom for both men and women.

reviews.author: Goo Eun-seo
reviews.text:
20170911, visited at 6:20 PM
3 servings of sirloin
Yukhoe
Makgeolli

Side dishes are common, but delicious.
Slice the green onion salad thickly diagonally and sprinkle with plenty of red pepper powder.
Properly aged sirloin is tender.
The taste of raw meat is not missing either.
People who feel comfortable sitting with their legs stretched out in a spacious room
Great place for a drink

reviews.author: subtle
reviews.text: It's a bit noisy since most people come to eat hangovers, but the food quality is good.

reviews.author: silktest expert
reviews.text:
We had 4 dishes for lunch and they were pretty good: gal-bi-tang, yuk-gae-jang, dol-soat-bibim-bap, and hae-mul-pa-jeon.
gal-bi-tang = beef broth soup with glass noodles
yuk-gae-jang = spicy beef soup with vegetables
dol-soat-bibim-bap = vegetables, egg & rice in hot stone dish
hae-mul-pa-jeon = seafood and vegetables pancake
I really liked the side dishes that came out together.

For lunch, I had galbitang, broiler sauce, stone pot bibimbap, and seafood pajeon. The side dishes that came with it were good.

reviews.author: Kristian Sumfleth
reviews.text: It's really delicious and authentic food. The meat grilled on Korean barbecue is perfect, and the side dishes are also very delicious. It has a quiet atmosphere perfect for spending time with friends or colleagues.

reviews.author: Roman Mara
reviews.text:
The worst Korean barbecue in Seoul! The service is terrible. The employees don't even know how to use the smoke exhaust. You will have to ask multiple times for lettuce leaves to be packaged. The same goes for scissors!
Stop now!

reviews.author: burart jp
reviews.text: The bone-in ribs were delicious.

reviews.author: Steffen Trabert
reviews.text: It's a really nice place!!

reviews.author: Mrs. Rani
reviews.text: I went to a nearby sundae soup place and it was closed so I went somewhere and it was delicious. First of all, the rice was well cooked and chewy, and the side dishes of bracken, egg rolls, bean sprouts, and green onion kimchi were delicious, but the seasoned crab sauce was perfect for my taste. The soft tofu stew was spicy and good, but there was no egg yolk. Why is that so? Haha, the 8,000 won galbitang was so rich and the soup tasted good. It's a good value restaurant. There are more customers drinking than eating.

reviews.author: Ga young Bae
reviews.text: This is a place I always go to when I'm drunk a lot in Itaewon. The food is good for a place that stays late, but the employees always speak informally and are unfriendly, so even though I had a good meal, I left in a bad mood. There was a time when I went to a restaurant around 5 a.m. and was kicked out because I ordered something that didn't fit the number of people or ordered something that was too low in price.

reviews.author: Seogun
reviews.text: The best restaurant in Itaewon, Chowon Restaurant, where all the food is delicious. I went there on the weekend, and it was so quiet that it wasn't like before, which made me feel sad. In the past, I couldn't go to Chowon Restaurant because there weren't enough seats, but Itaewon was really deserted, anyway! You really have to eat this place’s ‘Gopchang Hotpot’ two to three times, and you have to eat ‘Jeyuk Stir-fry’ three to four times. It’s a really, really delicious place. The 5 friends I took with me to introduce it all unanimously said that it was delicious and that it was a truly delicious restaurant. Ah! I added grilled mackerel at the end, and it was so delicious that it disappeared in an instant. (For reference, I went there for the first time and then the second time. Even though everyone was already full.) There is an outdoor table where you can eat in a slightly independent space, so it was nice to be able to eat with friends even though it was a bit cold in the winter. Thank you uncle and aunt for continuing to do business without disappearing from Itaewon!!! I'll go again next time~ (p.s The side dishes here are really good too. Especially the seasoned crab sauce...)

reviews.author: beomsoo im
reviews.text: My friend, who came for the first time, didn't know much and ordered two servings of pork. In a crowded place, he subtly tapped his friend on the head and shouted at him to leave. I thought he must have made a mistake, so I paid attention to the surroundings and ordered four servings, but he didn't tell me anything and kept yelling at me to leave, so I left feeling really embarrassed. I had enjoyed the food before, but when a friend who came for the first time ordered something wrong, I don't know if he was tired or sensitive, but he yelled at me and told me to leave ;; I am leaving a review without any lies. I didn't have a clue so I just left.

reviews.author: Cold flavored candy
reviews.text:
It's a place that's open late, so it's good for people who are going for the third or more meal.
However, the employees' tone of voice is often insincere, and they are very judgmental when you ask them to simply eat something.

reviews.author: Purple New
reviews.text:
One of the best sundae soup restaurants in Itaewon
It had a slightly fishy taste, but it didn't come from the meat. I liked that the amount of meat was generous and it wasn't paper-like like the franchises.
The soup seemed a bit thin.

Good to have soju with soup and rice

reviews.author: cj chung
reviews.text: It's a good value restaurant, the sundae soup is plentiful and the tripe casserole is perfect as a side dish with drinks. The downside is that it closes at 10 o'clock.

reviews.author: Jeong Eun-seon
reviews.text:
He is kind and does not change his attitude whether he goes with a group or alone.
The soup is clear, refreshing and hot.
There is no discomfort at all after eating, which makes it seem like a restaurant that brings out the natural taste of the ingredients rather than seasoning.
Highly recommended

reviews.author: Laughing
reviews.text:
Parking is difficult.

Sundaeguk 8,000 won.

You can enjoy a delicious meal by adding various toppings (salted shrimp, perilla seeds, seasoning, salt, pepper) to your taste.

reviews.author: That lucky day, there
reviews.text:
This is a famous sundaeguk restaurant located near Bogwang-dong Polytechnic University. Beef head soup, etc.
The menu is also diverse.
Friendly boss and wife
Come eat delicious food and have a good time~~~Delivery is also available~~~

reviews.author: Tiger Hyun
reviews.text:
I ate banquet noodles and fish cake noodles. It's a great place to have a quiet meal. It's ordinary, but the taste is as good as the famous Michelin noodle restaurant in town.

Bibim noodles are seasoned well and are delicious even without any special toppings. There are many cases where it is just spicy and disappointing, or only sweet and not spicy, but this one tasted like bibim noodles.

Fish cake noodles are like banquet noodles with fish cake skewers added. It's not salty and the seasoning is just right. The fish cake is ordinary. It looks the best at a low price. It's good because it's kimchi and not pickled radish. I gave it 4 stars because the service was good and friendly, but don't expect too much service.

reviews.author: Yumi Lee
reviews.text: After yesterday, I visited the Aewol Coastal Road restaurant for the second time today, Hill Jip Noodles~ Yesterday, there was a wait for about 5 minutes before 10 o'clock, but today, at around the same time, admission was completed without waiting. Yesterday, I had delicious meat noodles, but today I had bibim noodles. I am very happy that I was able to enjoy a delicious meal while enjoying the ocean view in a clean interior with unlimited rice provided.~~

reviews.author: Larry Mun
reviews.text:
I'm not a regular, but I've been visiting here every time I feel like eating bean noodles or bibim noodles for the past few years.

Even with people in the office, I often hang out in the summer.

One day this summer, the amount of bibim noodles seemed to be dwindling, so I asked the owner to add a double bowl menu because it was so delicious.

The female owner immediately replied that they don't have the double portion menu and that if you want more, you should order one more lol.

I was just complaining in a pleasant way, but hearing that cold answer made me lose my appetite... I haven't visited since then...

Naver's rating is good anyway so it will be maintained, but it feels like losing a good restaurant...ㅡㅡ;;;;

reviews.author: Doohyuk Lim
reviews.text: I had a really nice meal outdoors. It was delicious and had a great view!!

reviews.author: someda Y (We'll meet again)
reviews.text:
I recommend this place to everyone who reads this review.
The two owners treated me very kindly. Even though I didn't ask for an apron, they brought it to me. The price was reasonable and the taste was good.
It is said that he has been doing business here for 15 years. However, it is said that Usadan-gil is disappearing recently. I want to go again before it disappears.

reviews.author: Marine City
reviews.text:
Bogwang Elementary School, still filled with old-fashioned charm
There are several old restaurants near the hillside.
Among them, Bogwang-dong meat restaurant has been in business for 22 years.
My Hometown Raw Pork Belly (Opened in December 2001)

There are quite a few regulars and the tables are
There are about 8 tables, so it's not spacious.
Basic green onion salad with cold egg yolk
The cucumber salad is delicious.
Meat prices are average
I’m so glad that soju is 4,000 won.
I deliberately drank another bottle and left.
The fried rice is also good, so I recommend it.

There are many menus I haven’t tried yet.
I need to visit again sometime.
Please keep the current price the same.

reviews.author: Shark Shark
reviews.text: The owner was really friendly and the inside of the restaurant was clean, which was nice. The meat tasted good and the prices of the other options were also good. If I stayed in Itaewon a little longer, this is a restaurant I would go to one more time!!

reviews.author: Wontaek Lee
reviews.text:
The meat is really good. This is a famous pickled green onion restaurant.
The cold noodles are really delicious and you should definitely try the cheese fried rice.

reviews.author: Choi Dong-guk
reviews.text: When I first came here, I was so shocked by the pork neck pork that I had a dinner party here.

reviews.author: jaewoo park
reviews.text: If you are looking for a restaurant frequented by locals, we recommend the authentic Korean pork barbecue served with green onion salad and fried rice. This is my father's favorite menu.
